description: This file defines the AgentRouter class, which organizes and manages agent reasoners and skills, providing registration, delegation, and path management functionalities within a FastAPI-style framework.

classes.name: AgentRouter
classes.description: Provides organization for agent reasoners and skills, including registration, delegation, and path handling.

methods.name: reasoner
methods.description: Stores a reasoner function for later registration on an agent, wrapping it to ensure proper workflow tracking.

methods.name: skill
methods.description: Stores a skill function, merging router and local tags for registration.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Automatically delegates attribute access to the attached agent, enabling transparent proxying of agent methods.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Property to access the underlying Agent instance.

methods.name: _combine_path
methods.description: Generates a normalized API path for registered functions based on default, custom, and prefix settings.

methods.name: _attach_agent
methods.description: Internal method to attach an Agent instance to the router.
